summary: The committed board snapshot carries generated_at but has no trigger and no refresh path in this repository (Makefile has only board-gate:, governance/board/cli.py has no capture verb, governance/dispatch/snapshot.py has no refresh function, fleet/cron.py never mentions the board), so consumers resolve through a frontier that stops at issue #559 while the work in flight is EPIC #708 and its #723-#729 children: a legitimate issue origin is refused as origin-unresolved and an honest baseline deferral cannot be recorded

action: Make the board snapshot refresh a scheduled or evented action rather than a manual one, and have each consumer state the age it tolerates and refuse (or warn) beyond it, so staleness is measured instead of discovered

evidence.note: the merge that closes #727, the issue this action was tracked by: 'board triggers refresh-or-park on a stale snapshot' (PR #842)

remediation: trigger the refresh from the events that invalidate the snapshot and state the tolerated age in every consumer: a timestamp plus a tolerance without a trigger turns a data-staleness bug into a stopped lane (issue #727)
title: A committed snapshot needs a trigger, or its freshness rule becomes an outage
